senses.gloss:
अव् अव्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To please, to satisfy, Ragh. 11, 75.
 2. To be pleased, ved.
 3. To desire, Ragh. 1, 65.
 4. To take care, ved.
 5. To protect, Chr. 291, 13 = Rigv. i. 64, 13; Śāk. d. 1.
 6. † To move.
 7. † To excite affection, or be lovely.
 8. † To know, or apprehend.
 9. † To own (v. r. to be able).
 10. † To obey.
 11. † To act.
 12. † To shine.
 13. † To obtain.
 14. † To embrace.
 15. † To kill or hurt.
 16. † To take (v. r. to burn).
 17. † To be (v. r. to divide).
 18. † To grow.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. ऊत.
 --With the prep. प्र प्र, To help. Chr. 288, 2 = Rigv. i. 49, 2; Chr. 296, 5 = Rigv. i. 112, 5.
 --With सम् सम्, To satisfy, Chr. 297, 18 = Rigv. i. 112, 18.
 --Cf. ἄω; Lat. avere and uti (an old denominat.).
